title: Who pays for AI power bill households or tech

outro.text: Will households keep paying the forward bill while tech promises to pay its own way? Capacity price $28.92, now $329.17. Full breakdown linked below.

scenes.text: That is more than eleven times higher in two years.
The grid monitor says data centers caused 63 percent of the 2025-26 price increase.
IEEFA estimates 16 dollars a month more in Ohio, 18 in western Maryland.

card.title: Rotation calculation: the extra bill
card.source: IEEFA monthly estimates via Fortune ($16 Ohio, $18 W. Maryland) x 12 months

scenes.text: Multiply by twelve: 192 dollars a year in Ohio, 216 in western Maryland.
Capacity charges are only about 10 to 20 percent of a bill in this region.
32 of 34 governors-elect back stronger rules on data centers.
